title: Update self runs unbounded overridable update steps with full inherited env
description: Evidence: update self accepts --repo-url/BOREAL_UPDATE_REPO_URL, then runs git clone, pnpm install, pnpm build, and bash install.sh with raw spawn and {...process.env}. Those steps have no timeout and inherit developer secrets. Impact: a bad source or hanging lifecycle script can leak environment data, hang indefinitely, or mutate machine install targets.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-canonical update sources require an explicit unsafe override and the selected source/ref is reported clearly.
Update steps run with bounded timeouts and a minimal env allowlist, with tests for timeout and unsafe repo-url behavior.
